title: Yateem Hogaye Abbas Haye Wawaila
body:
Ali Ke Sher Ke Sar Se Ali Ka Saya Utha
Yateem Hogay Abbas Haye Wawaila
1- Chala Di Sar Pe Jo Talwaar Ibne Muljim Ne
Khuda Ka Ghar Huwa Rangeen Khoone Haider Se
Bicha Ke Farshe Aza Keh Rahe Hain Ahle Aza
2- Shaheed Kar Diya Sajde Me Ik Namaazi Ko
Ye Kamsini Me Mila Kaisa Daag Gazi Ko
Pisar Ki Aankho Se Rukte Nahi Hain Ashqe Aza
3- Ali Ka Laal Ye Manzar Kabhi N Bhulega
Lahu Me Duba Huwa Sar Kabhi N Bhulega
Padar Ke Baad Gazanfar Ki Khaak Hai Duniya
4- Wo Jisne Loriya Dekar Sulaya Bete Ko
Wo Jisne Ungli Pakad Kar Chalaya Bete Ko
Janaza Uthta Hai Aise Kareem Baba Ka
5- Fir Ahlebait Pe Allah Kya Musibat Hai
Hasan Ke Kandho Pe Shere Khuda Ki Mayyat Hai
Uda Ke Khaak Ye Jibreel Padhte Hain Nouha
6- Zami Ko Chain Nahi Gam Se Aasma Nam Hai
Abu Turaab Ki Mazloomi Ka Ye Aalam Hai
Jaha Se Roze Ki Haalat Me Rozadaar Chala
7- Jo Bhar N Payega Wo Zakhm Dil Pe Khaya Hai
Ali Ke Laal Ne Ye Pehla Gam Uthaya Hai
Dilaasa Deti Hai Bhai Ko Saniye Zahra S.A
8- Ali Ko Asr Ka Manzar Lahu Rulata Hai
Wo Khooni Dasht Jo Moula Ko Yaad Aata Hai
Jari Ke Baazu Gala Choomte Hain Sarwar Ka
9- Libaase Sog Me Farhaan Sara Aalam Hai
Kahi Pe Nouha Hai Rizwa Kahi Pe Maatam Hai
Jari Ko Deta Hai Ye Keh Ke Har Koi Pursa
